predicate: Does the exact corporate donor satisfy incorporation/registration criteria at receipt?
source_specific_evidence: EC donation template has company registration number and receipt/acceptance/return dates; Companies House establishes legal identity, not every eligibility fact.
novelty_or_rejection: S06 is sanctions; I02 common control; this tests non-sanctions donor eligibility.
next_check_or_stop: Read the exact company entry and donation disposition; present company status is insufficient.

predicate: Was the company actually carrying on UK business at receipt?
source_specific_evidence: Official guidance explicitly says dormant/liquidation/late accounts can coexist with carrying on business.
novelty_or_rejection: Same eligibility formulation, not a second discovery.
next_check_or_stop: Require affirmative period-specific activity evidence or reliable contrary admission; reject dormant-status proxy.

predicate: Was an apparently problematic receipt accepted and retained or returned?
source_specific_evidence: Public template distinguishes received, accepted, returned and dealt-with dates.
novelty_or_rejection: A receipt is not automatically an accepted prohibited donation.
next_check_or_stop: Read amendments, returns and actual legal deadline; no fixed deadline is inferred here.

predicate: Does a precise signed risk representation conflict with an established site condition at the question date?
source_specific_evidence: Docket/exhibit IDs can anchor application and engineering report; tailings portal is only a site lead.
novelty_or_rejection: P05 claim-versus-established-fact specialization; not new merely because insurer is audience.
next_check_or_stop: Get actual question, answer, insured site and engineering evidence; allegations are not findings.

predicate: Does the insurance actually held satisfy a particular public-contract coverage requirement?
source_specific_evidence: Policy schedules, endorsements, exclusions and certificate are distinct records; issuer insurance totals do not establish site coverage.
novelty_or_rejection: Required safeguard versus actual instrument is X08 with insurance instead of reclamation security.
next_check_or_stop: Need operative insurance requirement and full policy, not a certificate alone; route unverified.

predicate: Does an insurer allegation establish a false application?
source_specific_evidence: Complaint describes contested positions, not established falsity, knowledge or materiality.
novelty_or_rejection: No defensible allegation based only on a docket label and hazard.
next_check_or_stop: Require underlying evidence and disposition; otherwise no inference.

predicate: Did a verified 501(c)(3) organization itself transfer its assets to a candidate campaign as a contribution?
source_specific_evidence: Tax return EIN/classification must bridge to actual organizational donor; FEC receipt type, committee, amendments/refund and underlying transfer matter.
novelty_or_rejection: X05 tests lobbying declarations; this tests distinct candidate-campaign use of charity assets, not a reporting denial.
next_check_or_stop: Verify donor is organization rather than employee and recipient is candidate campaign; then tax status at transfer.

predicate: Can an employee contribution be attributed to the charity listed as employer?
source_specific_evidence: FEC individual contribution documentation distinguishes employer from contributor.
novelty_or_rejection: No: employer appearance does not establish funding, reimbursement or organizational endorsement.
next_check_or_stop: Do not promote employer-name matches; no case search performed.

predicate: Does an ordinary grant to an affiliated advocacy entity establish campaign subsidy?
source_specific_evidence: Separate entities, restricted grants and charitable activity can be lawful; recipient category does not identify end use.
novelty_or_rejection: Generic grant/affiliation overlap is not the Q02 direct-asset predicate.
next_check_or_stop: Need grant terms, actual use and campaign transaction; missing ledger, no inference.

predicate: Was a specifically covered assignment completed before an expressly required consent?
source_specific_evidence: Original contract clause and closing evidence must identify same licence/right, parties and date.
novelty_or_rejection: X07 prerequisite-before-action sequence specialization; not a new mechanism count.
next_check_or_stop: Check whether the clause covers the exact transaction and all amendments/consents; Land Matrix status is not closing evidence.

predicate: Does deemed consent, notice or an intra-group carve-out satisfy the clause?
source_specific_evidence: Notice receipt, response deadline, consent condition and waivers may resolve apparent chronology.
novelty_or_rejection: Mandatory falsifier inside REF-CONS, not extra hypothesis.
next_check_or_stop: Read whole operative clause and actual notification chronology.

predicate: Does shareholder change automatically breach a licence-assignment clause?
source_specific_evidence: Share transfer, asset transfer and change-of-control definitions differ.
novelty_or_rejection: Do not substitute investor-name change for a covered assignment.
next_check_or_stop: Reject unless operative clause expressly covers the transaction.

predicate: Does a precise zero-availability statement conflict with actual output of the same unit and interval?
source_specific_evidence: ENTSO-E differentiates production/generation units, MW capacity and actual output; EIC/unit hierarchy and revision history required.
novelty_or_rejection: R14 status-versus-operation refinement at shorter interval, not new.
next_check_or_stop: Identify the exact unit and statement version; regional generation cannot contradict a unit outage.

predicate: Was a required market notice published late?
source_specific_evidence: Event time, publication time and latest revision are different; current view cannot reconstruct first notice.
novelty_or_rejection: Potential distinct disclosure-timing obligation not established here.
next_check_or_stop: Need historical publication receipt/archive and applicable rule; no deadline asserted.

predicate: Does a price move near an outage prove an operator profited from false information?
source_specific_evidence: TMX instruments lack an established European asset/operator-position bridge; price correlation does not establish trades or intent.
novelty_or_rejection: No causal or profit claim from price/output co-movement.
next_check_or_stop: Need actual positions, trading counterfactual and disclosure evidence; omitted as unavailable.

predicate: Does an explicit sovereign no-guarantees statement or expressly complete guarantee schedule omit a proven operative guarantee?
source_specific_evidence: AidData has original contract repository; EDGAR can contain sovereign reports. Must establish signature, guarantee scope, covered liability and report perimeter/date.
novelty_or_rejection: N01 reconciles aid accounts and X14 identical statements; this tests a stated contingent-liability perimeter against an operative instrument.
next_check_or_stop: Read exact report assertion and original guarantee; do not start from country totals or commitments.

predicate: Does summed announced loan commitment exceeding a debt stock prove hidden debt?
source_specific_evidence: Commitment, disbursement, amortization, guarantees, public enterprises and government perimeter differ.
novelty_or_rejection: Aggregate mismatch alone fails an instrument-level obligation test.
next_check_or_stop: Reject without outstanding exposure, valuation and matched perimeter.

predicate: Does no mention of a contract in a report establish nondisclosure?
source_specific_evidence: SEC form allows incorporated exhibits and differs by debt category; current Form 18-K expressly excludes intergovernmental debt from one item.
novelty_or_rejection: Only an affirmative denial or demonstrably complete in-scope schedule supports Q03.
next_check_or_stop: Search all incorporated documents, exemptions and report definitions; no comprehensive coverage established.

predicate: Did possession precede availability of compensation for an already recognized claim under the applicable project requirement?
source_specific_evidence: Claim/parcel ID must join award, payment availability or approved escrow and actual possession date; project ID alone insufficient.
novelty_or_rejection: X02 obligation-versus-receipt and X07 prerequisite sequence specialization; not new.
next_check_or_stop: Confirm eligibility, amount, applicable framework and what made compensation available before comparing dates.

predicate: Can visible buildings or modelled population identify unpaid eligible claimants?
source_specific_evidence: Structures and population estimates do not identify legal claimant, ownership, eligibility or payment.
novelty_or_rejection: Would repeat the invalid demographic leap explicitly excluded in Z02.
next_check_or_stop: Reject; requires independent claimant/parcel records.

predicate: Can approved escrow resolve a missing direct receipt?
source_specific_evidence: ESS5 guidance reproduces exceptional escrow provision and conditions; project applicability and actual deposit still necessary.
novelty_or_rejection: Ordinary explanation within REF-COMP; not a separate test.
next_check_or_stop: Check prior Bank agreement, deposit and scope; a budget line is not an escrow deposit.

predicate: Does a component-specific signed inspection certificate conflict with a contemporary established component condition?
source_specific_evidence: TSB occurrence/airframe identifier is not component serial or release ID; court exhibits may contain originals but their availability is unverified. FAA covers US registrations only.
novelty_or_rejection: Potential documentary contradiction, but no complete component-to-certificate route identified.
next_check_or_stop: Need part/serial, release, inspector scope, exact inspection time and intervening events; do not use later failure as proof.

predicate: Does the same safety-critical defect recur after documented rectification?
source_specific_evidence: TSB published advisory documents an example maintenance timeline; it is not an independently reproduced investigation.
novelty_or_rejection: Already P02 defect-after-rectification with another transport mode.
next_check_or_stop: Need component/defect identity and repair evidence; do not count new source mode as new mechanism.

predicate: Do reconstructed hours/cycles exceed a component’s certified remaining life?
source_specific_evidence: Registry airframe serial/owner cannot provide serialized component installation/removal and life records; maintenance standard index is not those records.
novelty_or_rejection: Potential distinct conservation-of-life-history test, but original log chain remains unavailable.
next_check_or_stop: Need manufacturer limit, part serial and complete hours/cycles/reset/overhaul history; neither ADS-B nor tail registration substitutes.
